cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(sakura_uri LANGUAGES CXX)

# Generated by tools/build/sakura_build.py. Do not edit.
get_filename_component(SAKURA_REPO_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../../../../../.." ABSOLUTE)
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../cmake-msvc-x64-debug.cmake")
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_OBJECT_PATH_MAX 220)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_LIBRARIES "")

add_library(sakura_uri STATIC
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/platform/uri/UriIdentity.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/platform/uri/UriIdentity.h"
)
target_include_directories(sakura_uri PUBLIC "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core")
target_compile_features(sakura_uri PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
set_property(TARGET sakura_uri PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreadedDebug")
target_compile_options(sakura_uri PRIVATE /source-charset:utf-8 /execution-charset:utf-8 /Zp8 /Zc:wchar_t "/FI${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/src/main/modules/generated/abi/cmake-msvc-x64-debug/sakura_uri.h")
target_compile_definitions(sakura_uri PRIVATE _ITERATOR_DEBUG_LEVEL=2 _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00 NOMINMAX UNICODE _UNICODE)
